navbar-title: Application title displayed at the top left of the navigation bar.
navbar-home: Navigation link to the home page.
navbar-edit-counts: Navigation link to the page showing edit counts.
navbar-editor-counts: Navigation link to the page showing the number of editors.
navbar-watchlist: Navigation link to the user's watchlist page.
navbar-loading: Text shown in the navigation bar while the user's login status is being checked.
navbar-login: Label of the button that logs the user in.
navbar-logout: Label of the button that logs the user out.
navbar-open-menu: Accessible label (screen readers) of the button that opens the mobile navigation menu.
navbar-close-menu: Accessible label (screen readers) of the button that closes the mobile navigation menu.
